bullets.text: Portfolio contacted (12 months) held steady at 87.2% this week, ranking second among its three peers.
Show rate fell 6.0% to 91.3% while no-show rate reached 8.7%, and both rank third among the three peers.
Rosemont's show rate fell 23.1% to 76.9%, and Longueuil's fell 8.1% to 88.9%.
Laval Chomedey's portfolio contacted rose 0.6% to 80.2%, still ranking 14th of 14 branches.
Activities per advisor rose 8.4% to 17.7 this week, ranking third among the three peers.
